definitions.gloss: oral medication; medicine taken by mouth; internal medicine (as opposed to topical)
definitions.explanation: Medicine designed to be swallowed and absorbed through the digestive system, as opposed to medicines applied to the skin, injected, or inhaled. A formal medical and pharmaceutical term.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{内服薬|ないふくやく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{食後|しょくご}→食後：09499_shokugo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{飲|の}んで→飲む：00322_nomu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please take this oral medication after meals.

examples.japanese: {内服薬|ないふくやく}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{外用薬|がいようやく}→外用薬：24270_gaiyouyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{処方|しょほう}→処方：05976_shohou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Both oral medication and topical medication were prescribed.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{症状|しょうじょう}→症状：03234_shoujou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{内服薬|ないふくやく}⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{注射|ちゅうしゃ}→注射：01665_chuusha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方|ほう}→方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{効果的|こうかてき}→効果的：04793_koukateki⟧だ。
examples.english: For this condition, injections are more effective than oral medication.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{内服|ないふく}→内服：21858_naifuku⟧ (internal use, oral administration) and {薬|やく} (medicine). A medical and pharmaceutical term for medication that is swallowed and absorbed through the digestive system, as opposed to topical, injected, or inhaled medicines.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {内服薬|ないふくやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧: to take oral medication
- {内服薬|ないふくやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{処方|しょほう}→処方：05976_shohou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to prescribe oral medication
- {内服薬|ないふくやく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{副作用|ふくさよう}→副作用：05015_fukusayou⟧: side effects of oral medication

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{外用薬|がいようやく}→外用薬：24270_gaiyouyaku⟧: topical medicine — applied externally (creams, ointments)
- ⟦{飲|の}み{薬|ぐすり}→飲み薬：19044_nomigusuri⟧: oral medicine — the everyday word for medicine you drink/swallow
- ⟦{塗|ぬ}り{薬|ぐすり}→塗り薬：17374_nurigusuri⟧: ointment, cream — everyday word for topical medicine
- ⟦{注射|ちゅうしゃ}→注射：01665_chuusha⟧: injection

REGISTER:
{内服薬|ないふくやく} is a formal/medical term. In everyday speech, ⟦{飲|の}み{薬|ぐすり}→飲み薬：19044_nomigusuri⟧ is more common.
